modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Murray is questionable for Monday's game against the Rockets due to a left shin contusion.
injury.detail: Murray could miss his first game of the season due to a right lower leg injury. If he is unavailable, Tyus Jones could see an expanded role.

injury.shortComment: Quickley (hamstring) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
injury.detail: Quickley is in danger of missing a second consecutive contest due to a right hamstring injury. If the 27-year-old point guard remains sidelined, Jamal Shead and Alijah Martin would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Braun (calf/illness) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Houston.
injury.detail: Braun is under the weather and also dealing with a left calf contusion. Nikola Jokic (elbow), Jamal Murray (shin), Aaron Gordon (lower body), Cameron Johnson (lower body) and DeMar DeRozan (back) are all listed as questionable as well, so the Nuggets could be shorthanded Monday. If Braun is ruled out, Spencer Jones, Cam Whitmore and Bryce Hopkins would be candidates for increased minutes.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (lower body) is questionable for Monday's game against Houston.
injury.detail: Johnson has already missed three games this season. If he is unavailable for a fourth time Monday versus the Rockets, it could mean more minutes for Spencer Jones and Alpha Diallo.

injury.shortComment: Gordon (lower body injury management) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Rockets.
injury.detail: Along with Nikola Jokic (elbow), Jamal Murray (shin), Christian Braun (calf/illness), Cameron Johnson (lower body) and DeMar DeRozan (back), Gordon is questionable to play Monday. If the veteran forward is unable to go, Trevon Brazile, Spencer Jones and Alpha Diallo would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Davis (ankle) is listed as questionable for Monday's game in Detroit.
injury.detail: Davis has missed the last two games. It appears he has a chance to return Monday against the Pistons. However, if Davis isn't cleared to suit up for that contest, Bilal Coulibaly could remain in the starting lineup. Deandre Ayton (leg), who is not listed on the injury report, is also a candidate to start.

injury.shortComment: Vassell is questionable for Monday's game against the Suns due to left adductor tightness.
injury.detail: Vassell could miss his first game this season. If he is unable to go, Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson and Carter Bryant could see extra minutes.

injury.shortComment: Jokic (elbow) is listed as questionable for Monday's game in Houston.
injury.detail: Jokic nearly had a triple-double in Saturday's 114-102 win over the Pacers. However, he's now in danger of missing his first game of the 2026-27 season due to a right elbow sprain. If Jokic isn't available to suit up, Marvin Bagley would presumably take his place in the starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Grimes (finger) did not return to Sunday's game against the Pistons.
injury.detail: Grimes went back to the locker room in the fourth quarter due to an apparent finger injury and was unable to return. He should be considered questionable at best for Monday's game against the Hawks.

injury.shortComment: Barnes (adductor) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
injury.detail: Barnes was held out of Friday's win over Milwaukee and could miss a second straight game due to left adductor soreness. If the star forward remains on the inactive list alongside Kawhi Leonard (knee), Collin Murray-Boyles, Allen Graves and Jamison Battle would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: DeRozan is questionable for Monday's game against the Rockets due to lower back spasms.
injury.detail: DeRozan missed Wednesday's game against the Raptors due to back spasms, which now has him questionable for Monday's contest. If he is unable to go, Alpha Diallo, Bryce Hopkins and Trevon Brazile are candidates for increased minutes.

injury.shortComment: Santos (knee) is listed as probable for Monday's game against New Orleans.
injury.detail: Santos' knee issue isn't anything new, so he'll be on the floor Monday, barring a setback. The 24-year-old has appeared in seven regular-season games in 2026-27, averaging 6.6 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 18.9 minutes per contest.

injury.shortComment: Allen (knee) is questionable for Monday's game against Charlotte.
injury.detail: Allen has missed the last two contests due to a bruised right knee. Sam Merrill (elbow) is also sidelined, so Meleek Thomas may remain in the starting lineup, with Peyton Watson sliding over to the four and Evan Mobley handling things at the five.

injury.shortComment: Diabate (quadriceps) is questionable for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.
injury.detail: Diabate could miss a second straight game due to a right quad injury. If he is unavailable, Ryan Kalkbrenner could see extra minutes.

injury.shortComment: McConnell is questionable for Monday's game against the Mavericks due to a right hamstring strain.
injury.detail: McConnell missed the first nine games of the season due to a hamstring injury, which could hold him out for Monday's contest. If he is unavailable, Quenton Jackson is expected to see an expanded role.
